pc.sched.subtitle: Saved on this computer only
pc.sched.howItWorks: A scheduled message goes out on the first check after its time. If OSHI is closed then, it goes out late, the next time OSHI opens, and says so. Nothing wakes this computer.
pc.sched.noRecipients: Add a contact or join a group before scheduling a message.
pc.sched.exactHint: Or type an exact date and time: year-month-day hour:minute.
pc.sched.empty.title: Nothing scheduled
pc.sched.empty.body: Choose who, type the message, then choose when it should go out.
pc.peers.title: Nearby peers
pc.peers.subtitle: OSHI devices on this network, with no internet needed
pc.peers.notice.on: Scanning. This computer is visible on the network again.
pc.peers.notice.meshOff: The local network mesh is not running in this window, so there is nothing to announce. Start OSHI with --mesh; until then this list stays empty.
pc.peers.notice.refused: Discovery did not start. The mesh is running, so the network is refusing multicast; it is not a setting.
pc.peers.notice.off: Scanning off. Nothing is announced and nothing is looked for; open connections are left alone.
pc.peers.meshOff.title: The local network mesh is off
pc.peers.meshOff.body: This window was started without --mesh, so nothing is announced or looked for. Start OSHI with --mesh to find devices on this network.
pc.peers.empty.title: Nobody found yet
pc.peers.empty.body: A device appears here within seconds of joining the same network. If one never does, the two are probably on different subnets, or mDNS is blocked.
pc.peers.disconnected: Disconnected from %@. Discovery may reconnect; to stop that, block them or turn scanning off.
pc.peers.announce: Announce this computer and look for others
pc.peers.announce.hint: Both at once: turning this off also stops announcing your name and key on the network. Open connections are left alone.
pc.peers.byHand.hint: When discovery cannot see a device (another subnet, or mDNS blocked). Its identity is still checked when it connects.
pc.peers.badAddress: Give an address and a port from 1 to 65535.
